newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa revises up Apr-Aug revenue by 5 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa revises up Apr-Aug revenue by 5 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's Finance Department said on Friday it had revised up its estimate of April-August revenue to 55.56 billion from 50.37 billion given previously.
The move follows a miscalculation due to software errors, the department said in statement.
The department also revised data for April to August last year to 49.273 billion rand from the 48.564 billion rand originally stated.

This meant that total revenue receipts for April to August 1996 were 12.8 percent more than the comparable figure for the same period last year and represented about 38.3 percent of the total 144.9 billion rand budget.
It said revenue receipts would improve over the next three months when provisional taxes were paid.
The department said that spending figures remained unchanged at 18.476 billion rand in the month and 72.802 billion rand in the first five months of the fiscal (April-March) year.
